cross_object_findings.finding: A successful GitHub Actions run can be bound to an exact head while causal semantics remain independently UNKNOWN if reviewers cannot inspect code/tests/artifact payload. Execution identity, qualification and semantic proof must remain distinct.

Multiple reviewers repeatedly returned UNKNOWN/BLOCK_EVIDENCE because their environments lacked exact primary objects. These attempts consumed coordination without changing the WP2 claim; evidence routing should be solved once rather than by repeated review invocation.

The observed relaunch dependence is explained by lack of a reliable wakeup/dispatch trigger after external changes, while repository-native fresh-worker recovery is already demonstrated. A new Quant reasoning/control plane is not warranted.

Existing scheduled wakeups/Automations plus GitHub durable state and bounded workers are the recommended minimum. A persistent supervisor or bespoke controller is conditional only on a failed single-launch test proving a missing primitive.

Owner intermediation is reduced by preauthorized authority envelopes and machine-checkable policies. Consequential but reversible engineering decisions should proceed autonomously; human interruption is reserved for truly non-containable boundary crossings.

The revised model retains only four boundary classes: new/expanded live-capital authority, irreversible first unblinding/prospective exposure, redefinition of a frozen scientific protocol/lineage, and irreversible external mutation outside the signed envelope. Target normal-path Owner prompts = zero.
